ci-bot: ALERT: main pipeline -> RED (after merge #4820). Smoke-runner 3/8 failed. Failures: smoke/gpu-init (timeout), build/packager (exit 1), smoke/e2e-docker (container pull error). Logs: https://ci.redwood/6321/job/7890 :eyes: @eng-infra-oncall
Jordan: grabbing logs, will try a rerun. pinging packager owners. ETA ~5m
Maya: PR looked tiny — changelog tweak? if docs-only we can ignore. @Jordan was there a code change?
Jordan: not docs-only — there was a transitive bump to the packager dependency. failing snippet below:
```stderr
Error: failed to unpack layer: permission denied
/build/packager: exit code 1
```
Eli: can someone trigger a rerun of the smoke matrix? if rerun passes it's likely a flake, otherwise we need a bisect.
Jordan: rerun started: https://ci.redwood/6321/job/7901 :arrow_forward:
ci-bot: rerun finished — STILL RED. same build/packager failure. job 7901 logs: https://ci.redwood/6321/job/7901/logs
Avery: looks like a real regression, recommend bisect over merges in the last 6h and hold merges to main until we know. tagging packager owner. :handshake:
Maya: @Leo can you eyeball? if packager needs revert we should hotfix before more merges.
Leo: on it. taking ownership, will try local repro and open a revert PR if I can reproduce. ping me if you find a quick mitigation.
